# Pairee
> A dual-pane file manager for the terminal (TUI), inspired by Norton Commander and Far Manager. Written in Rust with Ratatui and Tokio. Windows, Linux and macOS.

Pairee is a single executable that keeps the keys of the classic two-panel file managers and adds what is needed today: background transfers, Git, remote connections, archives, a built-in viewer and editor, and sandboxed Lua plugins. It is in public beta.

## Features
- Two panels with tabs, quick view, tree, folder comparison and synchronization.
- Keyboard presets: Norton Commander / Far, Explorer / VS Code / Total Commander, Neovim and yazi; every key can be changed.
- Copy, move and delete in the background with progress, pause, cancel, undo and redo.
- Git: per-file status in the panels and a Git panel (stage, commit, diff, log, branches, stash, tags, clone).
- Remote panels: SFTP, FTP, S3 and WebDAV; passwords in the system keyring.
- Archives: zip, tar (.gz, .bz2, .xz) and 7z, browsed and changed like folders.
- Built-in viewer and editor with syntax highlighting, hex view, image previews and encoding detection.
- Find files by name and content, duplicate finder, disk usage, command palette.
- Sandboxed Lua plugins (Secure Mode) and a signed community registry.
- English and Spanish interface and help; TOML themes and translations.
- Self-updater that recognizes the install method and verifies SHA-256 and minisign signatures.

## Quick Installation

### Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FittyAr/Pairee/master/install.ps1 | iex
```
Installs to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\FittyAr\Pairee` (added to the user PATH).

### Linux
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FittyAr/Pairee/master/install.sh | sh
```
Installs to `~/.local/lib/FittyAr/Pairee` with a `pairee` command in `~/.local/bin`.

## Where Pairee keeps its files
- Windows: `%APPDATA%\FittyAr\Pairee` (`config`, `cache`, `plugin-data`).
- Linux: `~/.config/FittyAr/Pairee` (settings), `~/.cache/FittyAr/Pairee` (log), `~/.local/share/FittyAr/Pairee` (plugin data); `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, `XDG_CACHE_HOME` and `XDG_DATA_HOME` are honored.
- macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/FittyAr/Pairee` and `~/Library/Caches/FittyAr/Pairee`.
- Folders of earlier versions (`pairee`, `com.pairee.Pairee`) are moved into place on the first start; nothing is deleted.
